purpose: Shadow-score native student CEM candidate banks at dataset start and after student-executed simulator actions; test whether teacher-relative elite regret worsens on genuinely visited planner contexts without changing CEM or training.

upstream_baseline.claim: Reuse staged source and protocol provenance already validated by 25534994; no fresh commit verification claim.

cem.rng_rule: Seed each episode's solver once with 42; retain native generator continuation from t0 to t25. The paired no-shadow/shadow runs for the same task begin from identical solver RNG states. Never reseed between solves.

protocol.dataset_mode: Pinned World.evaluate dataset mode, one frozen episode per World instance, num_envs=1
protocol.source_boundary: Dataset-protocol-aligned singleton diagnostic, not verbatim upstream eval.py or a vectorized-50 timing comparison.

shadow_rule: At each native CEM batch's rounds 10, 20, and 30, return the unmodified student cost to CEM. Separately run teacher.get_cost on cloned pre-student info and identical cloned candidates. Teacher must never change candidate selection, action commitment, simulator transition, solver RNG state, or student parameters.

metrics.recall_at_120_formula: count(teacher top30 candidate indices appearing in student top120) / 30
metrics.standardized_elite_regret_formula: (mean teacher cost on student top30 - mean teacher cost on teacher top30) / max(population std of teacher costs on all 300, 1e-6); lower is better
metrics.primary: round30 standardized_elite_regret(t25) minus standardized_elite_regret(t0), paired within source episode
metrics.interpretation: t0 and t25 use different native candidate draws and different planner contexts; delta describes their joint on-policy shift, not an isolated observation-state causal effect.

paired_gate.require: For the first four collection tasks, run no-shadow and shadow student-only with identical initial task state and solver seed. Require equal per-solve pre/post RNG states, candidate shapes, CEM output actions/mean/var, committed actions, simulator states, and episode success. Use the shadow run as that task's diagnostic observation only after this gate passes.
paired_gate.failure_rule: Fail closed and do not analyze remaining tasks if the shadow changes any planner/environment output; preserve evidence.

validity.required_task_mapping: One World.evaluate episode at a time; each solve and each CEM batch carries the frozen task identity. t25 must follow exactly 25 committed env.step transitions, with pre-solve state equal to the 25th post-step state.
required_checks: selection manifest and freeze exact identity
reserved_holdout episodes are never evaluated, scored, or used for the decision; official dataset-wide preprocessing may read action/proprio/state columns
native 30-round CEM schedule and teacher shadow only at rounds 10/20/30
finite scores, actions, metrics, and timings
GPU telemetry every 5 seconds in job.log

diagnostic_go_rule.decision: GO_TO_SEPARATE_TRAINING_DESIGN only if matched coverage >=12/16, median episode-level primary delta >=0.05, and positive count >=ceil(0.75*n_matched). Otherwise NO_GO_OR_INCONCLUSIVE; never train or alter thresholds within this freeze.
diagnostic_go_rule.early_termination_rule: An episode ending before 25 actual env steps has t25_status=terminal_before_t25; do not extend, replace, or count it as a matched primary episode.

resources.gpu_telemetry: nvidia-smi utilization and memory sampled every 5 seconds into this job's job.log
resources.cluster_rule: All HDF5/model/simulator/shadow scoring only inside guarded PBS compute allocation; login node only SSH/qstat/qsub/small control files.

claim_boundary: Only the 16 collection tasks are evaluated, shadow-scored, or used for this decision; reserved holdout task rows are not passed to World.evaluate or scored. Official dataset-wide preprocessing reads action/proprio/state columns, including holdout rows. A GO does not establish training benefit, official planner replacement, latency speedup, or closed-loop task success improvement.
